Evelyn, thanks for the quick turnaround and the docs. A few quick notes from our side after a 15-minute sync with Lena: 

- Timeline: June 7 start looks reasonable, but our QA lead is out June 9–11. Ideally a kickoff on June 8 and first test run the week of June 15. Can you be flexible on shifting the run window by a week if needed?
- Stakeholders: I’ll add the stakeholder roster but attaching an internal stakeholder CSV for your reference (shows who will be test owner and procurement contact).
- Security: We will need SOC 2 Type II and a short note on data retention and encryption-at-rest for the POC. Also, please confirm whether Redwood needs synthetic or deidentified samples for the initial runs.

Also, high level question on success gating: does Redwood expect a throughput target (tokens/sec) to be part of the pass criteria, or should we keep it strictly accuracy & latency SLA?

I’ve attached Stakeholder_Roster_Nova.csv (internal). I’ll review the checklist and get it back to you by EOD Monday.

Thanks Sanjay — appreciate the detail. A couple quick clarifications from the technical side: 

- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and a security addendum by EOD Monday. I’ll upload the redacted SOC 2 to the drive link and flag it in the doc.
- Data for runs: we recommend deidentified samples for the initial evaluation; synthetic is also fine for functional testing but we’ll need deidentified for any QA tied to real-world metrics. We can provide a short script to deidentify payloads.
- Pass criteria: we typically include three buckets — functional accuracy (business metric), latency (99th percentile), and operational throughput (tokens/sec or requests/min). If you prefer to keep throughput out of sign-off, we can make it an optional telemetry check.

Proposed small changes to the template (I’ll update the live doc before the workshop):
1) Add a column for expected test cadence (daily / weekly) so we can schedule automated runs.
2) Add a row for \"rollback criteria\" — clear conditions under which we stop the pilot.
3) Capture contact for infra support (who to page for incidents).

Monica — can you own scheduling the alignment workshop (30 min) next Wed (Jun 8) 09:00 PT? If not, propose the next open slot.
